intent.summary: Prevent pathological DOM traversal in HTML table title inference by adding a bounded loop guard.
intent.whyNow: A table title walk-up loop can become unbounded on certain pages, risking popup hangs and timeouts; the scraper must be deterministic.

decisions.title: Safety strategy for title inference loop
options: Cap traversal iterations and break safely
decisions.decision: Cap traversal iterations (50) and break when the element chain ends.
decisions.rationale: Avoids hangs with minimal behavior change on normal pages.

evidence.notes: Typecheck and build pass. Scraper no longer risks an unbounded parent traversal when table titles are missing.

followUps: Optional: record a lightweight debug metric when the safety cap is hit to spot problematic pages.
